chatbot.intro: Hello! 👋 I am the FSRE AI assistant. How can I help you today? You can ask me about the timetable, exams, labs, scholarships, or anything else related to the faculty.

schedule.text: Where can I see the timetable?

responses.schedule: You can find the timetable in the application's "Timetable" section. You can filter by study year and department. 📅
responses.exams: Exam registration is done through the Studomat system. Registration for the winter exam period is currently open until January 15. 📝
responses.labs: FSRE has modern laboratories for mechanical engineering, computer science, and electrical engineering. To book a lab, contact the appropriate assistants. 🔬
responses.scholarships: You can find information about scholarships on the official faculty website or by contacting the student office. 💰
responses.enrollment: Enrollment for the new academic year begins in June. A detailed schedule and requirements will be available on the faculty website. 🎓
responses.contact: The faculty is located at Matice hrvatske bb, 88000 Mostar. Phone: +387 36 355 025, Email: info@fsre.sum.ba 📍
responses.ebooks: Electronic textbooks are available via the eLearning platform. Log in with your student credentials. 📚
responses.wifi: The FSRE WiFi network is available to students. Login details are available at the student office. 📶
responses.thanks: You're welcome! 😊 If you have more questions, feel free to ask.
responses.greeting: Hello! 👋 How can I help you?
responses.unknown: Sorry, I'm not sure how to answer that. 🤔 You can ask me about the timetable, exams, labs, scholarships, enrollment, or contact information. You can also contact the student office for more details.
